method: Native Chrome, production benchmark fixture at 1920x1080. Same renderer/fields for both variants. Baseline disables NEB_BAKED_ONLY to compile the existing hybrid sampler; specialized enables it. Three rounds, alternating variant order, deterministically shuffled full/current close/inside cases. 24 warmup frames, 60 untrimmed asynchronous GPU samples per case. Readbacks/PNG capture after timing. First-round full HDR buffer plus all 8x8 witness tiles SHA256-compared. Timings exclude compilation, field baking, scene prep and readback; not application FPS or cold startup.
